desvios_do_criterio: The 200 seeds of fase1/1.8 (RandomState(20260926)) and the 100 of fase2/2.3 (RandomState(20260927)) share no seed; there are no '100 common split draws'. The validation of (H) was done by running (H) b=2 on the 100 seeds of 2.3 against Err_sigma_por_sorteio_A of fase2/2.3b_estimando_por_sorteio.json (per split draw) and c of fase2/2.3.

Per-node p_i is not stored in fase2/1.6_p_inclusao_por_no.json (profiles only); recomputed as the retention frequency over the same 100 split draws of 1.6 and checked against media_p_cond_te_geral of 1.6. Test nodes with p_i=0 at that frequency are discarded in the Hajek estimator (count in info_por_sorteio.n_descartados_p16_zero_no_teste).
Supplementary estimator J_p200 (not requested): Hajek with p_i = frequency over the 200 split draws themselves (no p_i=0 in the test set); sample-dependent p.
On the valid nodes, split draws with no valid node in the test set (M=0) are undefined in H/H0/J (n in statistics < 200; n_sorteios_indefinidos). A is always defined.
H0 has a larger test size than H (no trimming); A uses the size of H (held-out test set with b=2), as specified.
